name: Gulf Space Technology Public Company Limited
summary: Gulf Space Technology Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides transponder services for domestic and international communications in Thailand, Australia, India, Myanmar, and internationally. Its services include sale of user terminals of iPSTAR, broadband content services, sale of direct television equipment, internet services, satellite uplink-downlink services, providing technical support in relation to its satellite business, broadcasting television service, telecommunication, telephone network services, mobile content, satellite consulting, and engineering and development services for communication technology and electronics.
